lines.text: [Spotify's](/spˈɑtɪfˌIz/) shuffle was truly random. It felt repetitive.
Five heads in a row is random too. So what changed?
Since 2025, it makes several random orders.
Songs you just played lose points near the top.
Our test: just-played songs came first one time in four. Freshest of ten: one in twelve.
Building a feed? Keep it random, then pick the freshest of a few.
